name: victorino-discord-bot
description: Discord automation and server provisioning for VICTORINO.

scripts.prestart: node -e "const b=require('./src/animated-logo').getAnimatedLogo(); console.log('Animated logo validated:', b.length, 'bytes')" && node src/arrival-runtime-patch.js && node src/arrival-migrate.js && node src/name-migrate.js && node src/footer-migrate.js
scripts.check: node --check src/animated-logo.js && node -e "const b=require('./src/animated-logo').getAnimatedLogo(); if (b.length < 100) process.exit(1)" && node --check src/arrival-runtime-patch.js && node --check src/arrival-migrate.js && node --check src/name-migrate.js && node --check src/footer-migrate.js && node --check src/level-store.js && node --check src/welcome-card.js && node src/arrival-runtime-patch.js && node --check src/index-v4.js && node --check src/config.js
